scene.label: Act 2, Scene 5
scene.title: SCENE V. Rome. Another room in Philario's house.
scene.location: Rome. Another room in Philario's house.

lines.text: Is there no way for men to be, but women
lines.plainText: Is there no way for men to be but women

lines.text: Must be half-workers? We are all bastards,
lines.plainText: Must be halfworkers We are all bastards

lines.text: And that most venerable man which I
lines.plainText: And that most venerable man which I

lines.text: Did call my father was I know not where
lines.plainText: Did call my father was I know not where

lines.text: When I was stamp'd. Some coiner with his tools
lines.plainText: When I was stamp'd Some coiner with his tools

lines.text: Made me a counterfeit; yet my mother seem'd
lines.plainText: Made me a counterfeit yet my mother seem'd

lines.text: The Dian of that time. So doth my wife
lines.plainText: The Dian of that time So doth my wife

lines.text: The nonpareil of this. O, vengeance, vengeance!
lines.plainText: The nonpareil of this O vengeance vengeance

lines.text: Me of my lawful pleasure she restrain'd,
lines.plainText: Me of my lawful pleasure she restrain'd

lines.text: And pray'd me oft forbearance; did it with
lines.plainText: And pray'd me oft forbearance did it with

lines.text: A pudency so rosy, the sweet view on't
lines.plainText: A pudency so rosy the sweet view on't

lines.text: Might well have warm'd old Saturn; that I thought her
lines.plainText: Might well have warm'd old Saturn that I thought her

lines.text: As chaste as unsunn'd snow. O, all the devils!
lines.plainText: As chaste as unsunn'd snow O all the devils

lines.text: This yellow Iachimo in an hour, was't not?
lines.plainText: This yellow Iachimo in an hour was't not

lines.text: Or less; at first? Perchance he spoke not, but,
lines.plainText: Or less at first Perchance he spoke not but

lines.text: Like a full-acorn'd boar, a German one,
lines.plainText: Like a fullacorn'd boar a German one

lines.text: Cried "O!" and mounted; found no opposition
lines.plainText: Cried O and mounted found no opposition

lines.text: But what he look'd for should oppose and she
lines.plainText: But what he look'd for should oppose and she

lines.text: Should from encounter guard. Could I find out
lines.plainText: Should from encounter guard Could I find out

lines.text: The woman's part in me! For there's no motion
lines.plainText: The woman's part in me For there's no motion

lines.text: That tends to vice in man but I affirm
lines.plainText: That tends to vice in man but I affirm

lines.text: It is the woman's part. Be it lying, note it,
lines.plainText: It is the woman's part Be it lying note it

lines.text: The woman's; flattering, hers; deceiving, hers;
lines.plainText: The woman's flattering hers deceiving hers

lines.text: Lust and rank thoughts, hers, hers; revenges, hers;
lines.plainText: Lust and rank thoughts hers hers revenges hers

lines.text: Ambitions, covetings, change of prides, disdain,
lines.plainText: Ambitions covetings change of prides disdain

lines.text: Nice longing, slanders, mutability,
lines.plainText: Nice longing slanders mutability

lines.text: All faults that man may name, nay, that hell knows,
lines.plainText: All faults that man may name nay that hell knows

lines.text: Why, hers, in part or all; but rather all;
lines.plainText: Why hers in part or all but rather all

lines.text: For even to vice
lines.plainText: For even to vice

lines.text: They are not constant, but are changing still
lines.plainText: They are not constant but are changing still

lines.text: One vice but of a minute old for one
lines.plainText: One vice but of a minute old for one

lines.text: Not half so old as that. I'll write against them,
lines.plainText: Not half so old as that I'll write against them

lines.text: Detest them, curse them. Yet 'tis greater skill
lines.plainText: Detest them curse them Yet 'tis greater skill

lines.text: In a true hate to pray they have their will:
lines.plainText: In a true hate to pray they have their will

lines.text: The very devils cannot plague them better.
lines.plainText: The very devils cannot plague them better
